SCENE sc_001 0-34500 INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY
EP37:E1 0-5500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tilting down to a polished mahogany table as a white-gloved servant places a tall stack of wax-sealed wedding invitations onto a silver tray.
EP37:E2 1500-3200 SOUND: The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.
EP37:E3 5500-9500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.
EP37:E4 6000-9300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Cold, Calculating]: "Every important family in the county should witness it."
EP37:E5 9500-12500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.
EP37:E6 10800-12400 CATHERINE [Inquiring, Smug]: "The wedding?"
EP37:E7 12500-15000 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.
EP37:E8 12800-14800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Authoritative]: "The transfer of Ashbridge."
EP37:E9 15000-18800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.
EP37:E10 15600-18800 CATHERINE [Gloating]: "After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house."
EP37:E11 18800-23200 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.
EP37:E12 19000-23000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Sinister, Ruthless]: "And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us."
EP37:E13 23200-26500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.
EP37:E14 23800-26400 CATHERINE [Venomous Satisfaction]: "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."
EP37:E15 26500-30000 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.
EP37:E16 26600-29800 CATHERINE [Gleeful]: "Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests."
EP37:E17 30000-32500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.
EP37:E18 30200-32200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Decisive]: "Send the invitations."
EP37:E19 32500-34500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.
EP37:E20 32800-34500 CATHERINE [Spiteful]: "Especially to the Ashcrofts."
SCENE sc_002 34500-88000 INT. NOBLE MANOR - PARLOR – DAY
EP37:E21 34500-37000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down a palatial marble hall as a butler carries a silver tray toward double doors.
EP37:E22 37000-39800 CAMERA: Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.
EP37:E23 37000-39800 BUTLER [Formal]: "Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor."
EP37:E24 39500-44000 ACTION: Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
EP37:E25 44000-46800 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.
EP37:E26 44500-46500 LADY CLARISSA [Amused, Thrilled]: "Catherine's wedding."
EP37:E27 46800-49500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.
EP37:E28 47000-49200 NOBLEMAN [Observant]: "So it is finally official."
EP37:E29 49500-53000 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.
EP37:E30 50000-52800 LADY CLARISSA [Mockingly Reverent]: "Lady Catherine Ashbridge."
EP37:E31 53000-56000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.
EP37:E32 54000-56200 LADY CLARISSA [Intrigued]: "And after the ceremony..."
EP37:E33 56200-57200 NOBLEMAN [Curious]: "What?"
EP37:E34 56800-58500 ACTION: Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
EP37:E35 58500-62000 CAMERA: Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.
EP37:E36 58800-61800 NOBLEMAN [Reading in Awe]: "The sentencing of the condemned."
EP37:E37 62000-65500 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.
EP37:E38 62800-65500 LADY CLARISSA [Gloating, Mocking]: "They want the families to witness it."
EP37:E39 65500-69000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.
EP37:E40 66500-68800 NOBLEMAN [Fascinated]: "A public execution after a wedding."
EP37:E41 69000-72500 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.
EP37:E42 69500-72200 LADY CLARISSA [Chilling, Sharp]: "Not just an execution. A warning."
EP37:E43 72500-75500 CAMERA: Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.
EP37:E44 73000-74200 NOBLEMAN [Curious]: "To whom?"
EP37:E45 75500-82500 CAMERA: Close-up on Clarissa taking the letter back into her gloved fingers, her eyes gleaming with aristocratic cruelty.
EP37:E46 77000-81800 LADY CLARISSA [Contemptuous, Scornful]: "To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given."
EP37:E47 82500-88000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the parlor as Clarissa tosses the invitation dismissively onto the side table and looks directly toward the viewer.
EP37:E48 83000-87500 LADY CLARISSA [Smug Triumph]: "Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch."
SCENE sc_003 88000-116500 INT. ASHBRIDGE DUNGEON – CONTINUOUS
EP37:E49 88000-92000 CAMERA: Wide, dim shot of the subterranean stone dungeon. Juliana sits slumped against a weeping stone wall on the wet floor, dressed in a tattered prison smock, illuminated only by faint overhead moonlight piercing a ceiling grate.
EP37:E50 88500-92000 SOUND: Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.
EP37:E51 92000-95500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.
EP37:E52 93500-95500 ACTION: Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
EP37:E53 95500-100500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.
EP37:E54 96000-99500 JULIANA [Weak, Whispering through Tears]: "They think hunger will make me surrender."
EP37:E55 100500-103500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.
EP37:E56 100800-103200 JULIANA [Fierce Resolve]: "They think fear will make me beg."
EP37:E57 103500-108500 CAMERA: Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
EP37:E58 104000-107000 SOUND: The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
EP37:E59 105500-107800 JULIANA [Straining, Defiant Gasps]: "I will not!"
EP37:E60 108500-113500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.
EP37:E61 109000-112500 JULIANA [Passionate Defiance]: "They can take my name. They can take my home."
EP37:E62 113500-116500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.
EP37:E63 113600-116200 JULIANA [Indomitable Spirit]: "They cannot take who I am!"
SCENE sc_004 116500-156470 INT. NOBLE MANOR - PARLOR – NIGHT
EP37:E64 116500-120000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot in the dimly lit parlor, illuminated by the warm glow of the fireplace. Clarissa now wears a deep blue velvet gown, reclining in an armchair beside the nobleman.
EP37:E65 117200-119800 NOBLEMAN [Quietly Skeptical]: "Do you think she'll actually be executed?"
EP37:E66 120000-124500 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa giving a slight, dismissive scoff before turning to him with cold certainty.
EP37:E67 120500-124200 LADY CLARISSA [Dismissive, Certain]: "After what she has been accused of? Of course."
EP37:E68 124500-127000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.
EP37:E69 124800-126500 NOBLEMAN [Musing]: "She was always stubborn."
EP37:E70 127000-132500 CAMERA: Close-up on Clarissa's face hardening with bitter resentment.
EP37:E71 127500-132000 LADY CLARISSA [Bitter, Cold]: "That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly."
EP37:E72 132500-136000 ACTION: Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
EP37:E73 132500-141500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot showing Clarissa standing tall beside her husband, her posture regal and vindictive.
EP37:E74 134000-141000 LADY CLARISSA [Venomous Monologue]: "Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it."
EP37:E75 141500-147500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Clarissa's face glowing in the firelight. Her lips curl into a merciless smile as she lifts the crystal glass to her mouth and drinks.
EP37:E76 142500-146500 LADY CLARISSA [Chilling Proclamation]: "Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place."
EP37:E77 145500-148000 ACTION: Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.
EP37:E78 147500-156470 CAMERA: Slow push-in on the dark polished tabletop where the open invitation lies beside the wax seal. The bold Gothic lettering "EXECUTION CLAUSE" sits beneath the gold crest, while the fire dances reflected on the mahogany.
EP37:E79 148000-156470 SOUND: A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.
